$comment: fixScope cascade (each valid leaf independently): standard default → platform fixScope in scripts/lib/delivery-platform-preferences.json → tool fixScope merged by readSettings() from scripts/settings/*.json → env. Invalid overrides are ignored and reported. This empty block leaves standard/platform values in control. holdMode: active-session (default; only live fixer/build claims and fixes accepted this pass hold scope) | pr-lifetime (all ranked waiters retain holds); env WE_FIX_SCOPE_HOLD_MODE. overlapGranularity: region (default; old-side changed ranges widened on both sides, plus a clean trial merge required; unreadable/new/deleted/binary/directory/build scopes fail closed to file) | file; env WE_FIX_SCOPE_OVERLAP_GRANULARITY. regionMarginLines: integer 0..10000, default 20; env WE_FIX_SCOPE_REGION_MARGIN_LINES. priorityBypass: boolean, default true; env WE_FIX_SCOPE_PRIORITY_BYPASS accepts on/off/true/false/1/0. Priority passes ordinary or stalled holders, never an overlapping fix accepted this pass; sorts after urgent and before ordinary candidates. stalledAfterMinutes: positive finite number, default 30; env WE_FIX_SCOPE_STALLED_AFTER_MINUTES; heartbeat age for fixer claims, waitingSince age for pr-lifetime waiters. fastTrackLabels: string array, default ["fast-track", "priority:urgent"]; no env override. Priority also includes mainFix=true and build.priority. build.priority uses the same cascade under policy build (standard empty array → platform build → existing tool build → WE_BUILD_PRIORITY); array of positive PR numbers or "#123"/"123" strings; env accepts comma/space-separated PRs. Configure build.priority in its existing owner file, not here. Aging, rebase exemptions, stack relationships and urgent semantics are preserved. Policy decision logs name the deciding leaf and source layer; refusal text stays compatible.
